hero.title: Excellent pets, *excellent care*
hero.lede: A full-service clinic for dogs and cats in North Augusta, owned by Drs. Barry and Kim Strock: wellness care, surgery, dentistry, imaging, boarding and bathing.

items.title: Wellness & preventive care
items.text: Routine exams and the everyday care that keeps pets healthy for longer.

items.title: Surgery
items.text: Spay and neuter, soft-tissue and orthopedic surgery, and reconstructive surgery.

items.title: Dental care
items.text: Cleanings and dental treatment for a healthier mouth.

items.title: Cardiology
items.text: Heart care and monitoring for dogs and cats.

items.title: Diagnostic imaging
items.text: Imaging in the clinic to find answers sooner.

items.title: Nutrition
items.text: Diet advice for every age and condition.

items.title: Boarding
items.text: Personal dog kennels, a secluded cat area, and care for diabetic and special-needs pets.

items.title: Bathing
items.text: Baths to send your pet home fresh.

items.title: Microchipping
items.text: A permanent ID that helps a lost pet find its way home.

sections.title: Owned by veterinarians, *since 2001*
body: Dr. Barry and Dr. Kim Strock both studied at Clemson University, then met in veterinary school at Tuskegee University. In 2001 they opened Veterinary Healthcare Associates together, and they have been its proud owners ever since.
Dr. Ray Henley, a University of Florida veterinary graduate with decades of experience, joined the team in 2015, and head technician Shellie Robinson, LVT, joined in 2016.
list: Drs. Barry and Kim Strock, owners

sections.title: Boarding *with care*
sections.intro: Pets are fed once or twice a day, as you ask, with Hill’s Science Diet or their own food, and medications are given as directed.

columns.title: Included
items: A personal kennel for each dog
Care for diabetic and special-needs pets
One-on-one playtime, for an extra fee

columns.title: Please bring
items: Toys, labeled with your last name
Your pet’s own food, if they need it
Medications, and tell us when you book

columns.title: Please leave at home
items: Pet beds, which can be chewed or carry fleas

items.a: Yes. Doctor visits are by appointment only; call (803) 613-9123 to schedule.
Yes. We’re always welcoming new dogs and cats.
They come by text and email, so call to make sure we have your current number and address.

items.q: Can my pet stay with you while I travel?
items.a: Yes. Boarding includes personal dog kennels, a secluded cat area, and care for diabetic and special-needs pets.

sections.title: Book a visit
sections.text: Call to schedule an appointment for your dog or cat.
